changelog: One man, two firms, one mobile. The same number can now be listed under two customers — type it on New Order and it asks which firm the bill is for.

Opening the second firm is deliberate: tick "Another firm on this number". If a different name is typed against a known number without ticking it, the order is refused and explains what to do, rather than guessing.
The order screen and job card now print all three names: Order By (who took it), Prepared By (who made it) and Prepaid By (who took the advance) — plus the Contact Person.
Prepared By follows the designer on its own, and can be set by hand on the order screen when someone else finished the job.
New report — Reports → Work Done: every job with the customer, contact person, item, amount and all three names, with an Excel export button.
Fixed: reusing a known number with a different name typed in used to RENAME the existing customer, which would have moved all their past orders to the new name.
